Subject: Quiet window request: provisional GPU hold for QuartzAI late-stage

Ben / Marissa —

QuartzAI (QZ-4731) just entered final legal review. They asked for an explicit capacity assurance window to support an initial Dedicated deployment for inference: projected steady-state ~18 A100-equivalent GPUs with bursts to 30 for onboarding (first 4 weeks). Sales asked if we can place a provisional hold for two weeks while procurement finishes.

As usual, we don't want to block inventory unnecessarily — this is a late-stage buyer and they committed to a PO contingent on the hold. Can operations confirm:
- whether we can earmark 18 GPU-equivalents in us-west for 14 days starting 2029-04-09
- whether bursting to 30 is feasible (pre-warm plan?) and any cost uplift estimate
- what the earliest cancellation cutoff would be if the PO slips

Marissa — looping you for capacity verification and recommended hold mechanism (soft reserve / escrow / commit token). Ben / Monica, I'll be external-facing with Quartz.

Thanks,
Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quiet window request: provisional GPU hold for QuartzAI late-stage

Quick update — thanks Karthik.

Operationally I think we can do a 14-day soft-embargo (non-binding) that marks capacity in the scheduler and prevents new Dedicated commitments from consuming that pool. That would not remove the nodes from autoscale entirely but reduces the available headroom. To support bursting to 30, we need a pre-warm plan that reserves an additional 12 A100-equivalents as a cold pool that can be pulled into the Dedicated fleet for a short period; that's doable but carries a short-term cost hit (~15% uplift on projected monthly run-rate for that window).

Marissa — can you confirm node counts and whether us-west-2 has the contiguous GPUs to support the window 2029-04-09 -> 2029-04-23? If not, what cross-region fallback latency impact would we expect?

Ben
--
Ben Carter
Director, Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2029 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quiet window request: provisional GPU hold for QuartzAI late-stage

All — dug into fleet inventory and ran a quick allocation simulation. Highlights:

- Us-west-2 current free pool: 42 A100-equivalent GPUs across 9 nodes. We can earmark 18 for a soft-embargo without disrupting existing Dedicated customers if we apply the embargo to the per-tenant routing rule and disable autoscaling of those nodes for new assignments.
- Burst to 30 requires pulling up to 12 additional A100-equivalents from the general pool. If we pre-warm by reserving 12 into a cold standby, we will temporarily reduce spot/backfill capacity and increase cost as Ben noted.
- Contiguous allocation: to keep KV-cache locality and minimize cross-node overhead we prefer to allocate on 6 contiguous GPUs per rack when possible. We have two racks that can support that pattern in us-west-2.
- Cancellation cutoff: we recommend a 72-hour cancellation notice to unbind the soft-embargo cleanly. After 72 hours, the standby pool can be re-assigned.

I've attached a provisional matrix showing per-day tokenized cost uplift and node maps. If Ben/Karthik OK this, I'll open the embargo ticket in the capacity scheduler and mark QZ-4731 as the holder.

Attachments: provisional_capacity_matrix_QZ-4731.xlsx

-Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Senior Capacity Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@quartzai.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@quartzai.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2029 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: QuartzAI Dedicated onboarding: tentative capacity window and next steps

Alex — appreciate the rapid progress on PO routing. Short note to confirm we intend to place a provisional capacity window for QZ-4731 while legal/procurement finalizes terms. High-level notes: 

- We will implement a soft-embargo for 18 A100-equivalents in us-west-2 starting 2029-04-09 for a 14-day window.
- We plan to provision a 12-GPU cold-standby to enable bursts to 30 during onboarding; cost uplift estimated and will be invoiced if used.
- Cancellation: if we do not receive a binding PO by 72 hours before 2029-04-09 we will release the soft-embargo.

We want to avoid surprise blocks — this hold is provisional and intended only to protect the deployment window. Please confirm by replying to this note and share any required procurement paperwork.

Best,
Karthik
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@quartzai.com>

2) We need an explicit rollback SLA: if the hold impacts a higher-priority customer, can you confirm the escalation path and notice period?

If you can provide those two items I can accelerate approvals.
